pages.title: Gas Cooking Stove
pages.text: Right-clicking a gas cooking stove has a $(thing)50%%$() chance to light it; on a miss it just clicks, so try again.$(br2)Once lit it gives light level 12 and keeps consuming gas from an adjacent gas canister; when the gas runs out it turns back into a cold stove and must be lit again.$(br2)A cold stove has no block entity at all, so no heating check ever succeeds.

pages.title: Connecting the Canister
pages.text: A lit stove checks the $(thing)four horizontal directions$(); if one of them holds a $(thing)Gas Canister$() whose $(thing)front faces the stove$(), it gets a steady supply.$(br2)The canister's front is the face that pointed at you when you placed it; if it is the wrong way round, just rotate the canister.$(br2)Right-click a lit stove to put it out.

pages.title: Example
pages.text: The device sits on the stove, the canister beside it with its front facing the stove.

pages.title: What It Can Heat
pages.text: All heating only affects $(thing)the block directly above$():$(li)$(thing)Baking Tray$(): becomes ready to stir-fry$(li)$(thing)Oven$(): bakes without fuel$(li)$(thing)Advanced Furnace$(): burns continuously, no fuel$(li)$(thing)Cauldron with water$(): every 12 seconds it has a 15%% chance to drop one level$(br2)$(thing)The Deep Fryer does not use a gas cooking stove$() — its gas canister goes in the block behind it.

pages.title: Safety Notes
pages.text: $(li)Standing on a lit stove sets you $(thing)on fire and deals 2 damage$()$(li)A gas canister explodes when dangerous blocks (fire, magma blocks and the like) are nearby$(li)A lit stove also counts as a passive boiler heat source for $(thing)Create$() and as a heat source for the $(thing)Farmer's Delight$() heat-source tag, so those mods' devices can recognise it
